text: Thanks for coming in. We're hiring a site timekeeper. Our first candidate is... the Notebook.
G'day. I have fifteen years of experience.
Great. Any weaknesses?
Rain. Coffee. Dogs. And, occasionally, getting lost in the truck.
Can you calculate overtime?
I can calculate... vibes.
Thank you. Next candidate. Constra.
Hi! I clock in your whole crew with a photo and G P S.
Strengths?
Timesheets that build themselves. P D F or Excel, overtime included.
I do pages.
I also do schedules, invoices, R F Is, and change orders. Twenty-six tools. Twenty-three Excel templates.
Any weaknesses?
Honestly? I make the job look too easy.
That's not a weakness. That's a flex.
What about when there's no signal?
I keep working, and sync when you're back online.
I also work offline. Always. I'm paper.
Constra, when can you start?
Right now. I'm free while I'm launching.
I'll be in the truck.
Constra. Run the job, not the paperwork.
